summary: Resubmits the partial-replay experiment after fixing the semantic error that rejected the previous attempt. Comparisons were pointed at an admission alias whose prerequisite was their own result event; the harness now emits a separate rc_case_<case> event before each restart, carrying the mode, option flag, batch sizes, snapshot index, staged commit index, last log index and replay arithmetic, and both prerequisites are anchored there while the three comparisons stay on the rc_result_<case> events. The experiment itself is unchanged: a real single-node cluster commits 200 commands, snapshots, commits a second batch, shuts down and restarts from the retained stores, so the snapshot shortens the replay instead of eliminating it. A local run of the corrected harness reproduced both predictions, with the short case replaying 199 entries in four batches and returning in 3 ms, and the long case replaying 8299 entries in 130 batches without returning within five seconds. The three comparisons cover the short case's return, the requirement that it replay a non-zero tail of exactly four batches, and the long case's expected failure to return. The submission validates with zero schema errors, the harness file exists in the draft, and it requests one execution.
